names.each_name: Each name is a name with its replacement.
names.too_many_spellings: A name takes up to {n} spellings.
names.give_replacement: Give what to replace it with.
names.too_many_names: A list takes up to {n} names.
names.key_empty: That file has no names with a pseudonym beside them.
names.skip_shape: A skip is an entry's number and the find's place among its finds, 3:1.
names.agent_adds: Only the app does that. An agent adds, changes or takes off a name on the list with names add, names set or names remove, on his word.
names.agent_take: Only the app replaces a name written in lower case, one find at a time in Review and replace.
names.too_many_except: A name takes up to {n} phrases it is never found in.
names.add_who: That is no participant of this project. The participants: {list}.
names.add_held: Entry {n} of the list already has that name for the same people. Nothing was added.
names.add_twice: Two of the names given are the same. Nothing was added.
names.add_changed: The list changed while the names were added. Nothing was added: try again.
names.added: Added {n} to the list of names.
names.dry_added: Dry run: nothing was written. It would add {n} to the list of names.
names.add_found: {n} found in the transcripts already in
names.add_found_none: none found in the transcripts already in
names.no_list: This project has no list of names.
names.no_entry: There is no entry {n} in the list.
names.op: Names takes list, set, add, edit, remove, check, replace, preview, read-key or key-file.
names.edit_none: Say what to change: except phrases, whom it is for, the replacement or the spellings.
names.edit_changed: The list changed meanwhile. Nothing was changed: try again.
names.edited: Changed entry {entry} of the list of names.
names.dry_edited: Dry run: nothing was written. It would change entry {entry} of the list of names.
names.edit_nothing: Entry {entry} is like that already. Nothing was changed.
names.edit_field.except_removed: except phrases: {before}, {n} given to take off
names.record_set: Changed entry {entry} of the list of names to replace: {fields}.
names.record_remove: Took entry {entries} off the list of names to replace.
names.edit_finds: finds in the transcripts already in: {hits_before} to {hits_after}, a replace writing {replaced_before} to {replaced_after}
names.renumbered: The entries after it are numbered again: run names list.
names.history_line: Names from the project's list replaced in the transcripts already in: {replaced} replaced, {left} left as they were, in {participants}. The workbooks as they were are in each participant's _Archive.
names.replaced_said: Replaced {replaced} in {participants}. The transcripts as they were are in each participant's _Archive folder.
names.dry_replace: Dry run: nothing was written. It would replace {replaced} in {participants}.
names.demo_fixed: The demo has no list of names.
names.unticked: , a find unticked in the app: names replace leaves every find of it

names.line_held.one: {n} left as it is: a find of this name was unticked in the app's Review and replace
names.line_held.other: {n} left as they are: a find of this name was unticked in the app's Review and replace

names.line_lower.one: {n} in lower case left as it is, for the app's Review and replace
names.line_lower.other: {n} in lower case left as they are, for the app's Review and replace

names.held_entries.one: {n} name on the list was left whole: a find of it was unticked in the app's Review and replace.
names.held_entries.other: {n} names on the list were left whole: a find of each was unticked in the app's Review and replace.

names.remove_marked: Entry {n} has a find unticked in the app's Review and replace, so only the app takes it off. Nothing was removed: names set changes its Replace with and Except in and keeps it.
names.set_marked: Entry {n} has a find unticked in the app's Review and replace, so only the app changes its Name or In. Nothing was changed: names set changes its Replace with and Except in.
names.dry_removed: Dry run: nothing was written. It would remove {n} from the list.
